title: The South Current Where Questions Flow Through the Board

features.name: the-asking-current
features.desc-on-touch: South: where all questions flow. You cannot hold one; they drift down through the board like water remembering its river.

features.name: the-unmoored-compass
features.desc-on-touch: A glyph spinning slowly, its needle pointing south and not south and south again. The teacher's lesson still echoes here.

features.name: the-board-itself
features.desc-on-touch: A flat surface, barely visible, that questions pass through like light. You can almost see its edges.

inscription: south is not a direction; south is a question that learned to flow
